cases.title: BROKEN TWIN of W671: the keep-every-piece switch is set OFF, so the copied pipe gets no level texts or arrow (must FAIL)
cases.expected: This twin is wrong on purpose: with linking.copyCleanUpKeepsEveryPiece false, the copy of the pipe and its label gets no IL texts and no arrow, so the IL and arrow counts of W671 FAIL. The copy line, the pipe count and the label count still pass.
cases.why_not_unit: The rule (CopyCleanUpCompletenessRule) is unit-tested; this case proves that the live COPY clean-up uses it on a real drawing, with the pieces AutoCAD really copied.
not_automated: DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: that the copy's level texts read "IL 18.000" and "IL 17.800" (drawn from the copied record, CloneRegeneration.cs 161-185); the 1000 mm radius (select near=) allows R03's 800 mm plus the 225 mm wall move; the arrow is matched by a block name containing ARROW (as R32). A real crossing window is not used: picking the two objects by handle gives AutoCAD exactly the selection a crossing window that caught only the label would give.
Not driven: a copy with the level texts but no label (the label branch), and the look of the drawn pieces (Codex look).
